query: 'SELECT
    admission_id,
    patient_id,
    attending_doctor_id,
    CASE
        WHEN LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(department AS VARCHAR(100))))) IN ('cardio', 'cardiolgy', 'cardiology')
            THEN 'Cardiology'
        WHEN LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(department AS VARCHAR(100))))) IN ('emergancy', 'emergency', 'er')
            THEN 'Emergency'
        WHEN REPLACE(LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(department AS VARCHAR(100))))), ' ', '') IN ('gensurg', 'generalsurgery')
            THEN 'General Surgery'
        WHEN LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(department AS VARCHAR(100))))) IN ('neuro', 'neurology', 'nuerology')
            THEN 'Neurology'
        WHEN LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(department AS VARCHAR(100))))) IN ('onco', 'oncology', 'oncologyy')
            THEN 'Oncology'
        WHEN LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(department AS VARCHAR(100))))) IN ('ortho', 'orthopaedics', 'orthopedics')
            THEN 'Orthopedics'
        WHEN LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(department AS VARCHAR(100))))) IN ('paediatrics', 'pediatrics', 'peds')
            THEN 'Pediatrics'
        WHEN department IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(department AS VARCHAR(100)))) = ''
            THEN 'General'
        ELSE LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(department AS VARCHAR(100))))
    END AS department,
    COALESCE(
        TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(admission_date AS VARCHAR(60)))), 23),
        TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(admission_date AS VARCHAR(60)))), 101),
        TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(admission_date AS VARCHAR(60)))), 110),
        TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(admission_date AS VARCHAR(60)))), 107),
        TRY_CONVERT(DATE, REPLACE(LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(admission_date AS VARCHAR(60)))), '-', ' '), 106),
        TRY_PARSE(LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(admission_date AS VARCHAR(60)))) AS DATE USING 'en-US')
    ) AS admission_date,
    COALESCE(
        TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(discharge_date AS VARCHAR(60)))), 23),
        TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(discharge_date AS VARCHAR(60)))), 101),
        TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(discharge_date AS VARCHAR(60)))), 110),
        TRY_CONVERT(DATE, LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(discharge_date AS VARCHAR(60)))), 107),
        TRY_CONVERT(DATE, REPLACE(LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(discharge_date AS VARCHAR(60)))), '-', ' '), 106),
        TRY_PARSE(LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(discharge_date AS VARCHAR(60)))) AS DATE USING 'en-US')
    ) AS discharge_date
FROM bronze.admissions
WHERE admission_id IS NOT NULL',
